The default configuration works out of the box: requests to `opencode.ai` automatically get **`x-"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"opencode-session`** (the session header used by the opencode gateway) plus `x-session-affinity` / `x"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"-client-request-id` / `x-session-id`. **The header value defaults to a pure-alphanumeric nanoid(8) d"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"erived from the uuid portion of the session id** (e.g. `0RpJJnxJ` — the `session-` prefix does not p"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"articipate in the hash; the token is deterministically derived from the uuid via SHA-256). With `ver"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"bose: true`, the journal logs the mapping between the original id and the wire token:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The opencode gateway branch uses `x-opencode-session` to carry the session id; this plugin listens o"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"n the `llm/stream` scope, wraps `fetch`, and adds that header at the wire layer. By default it hashe"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"s the uuid portion of `session-<uuid>` (the `session-` prefix is excluded) into an alphanumeric nano"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"id(8) before it goes on the wire. **Only request headers are touched** — the request body, URL, meth"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"od, and everything else pass through unchanged. See docs/design.md for the full design rationale."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"**Zero configuration needed by default** (the install command above is all you need). To enable inje"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ction logging through the patch layer:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"All options (each optional, defaults shown):"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Key | Default | Description |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| `providers` | `[opencode, opencode-go]` | llm-pi-ai route names whose sessionId should be tagged |"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"
| `hosts` | `[opencode.ai]` | URL host suffixes (including subdomains) that get session headers |
|"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" `baseURLs` | `[]` | Additional exact URL prefixes to match (custom gateways) |
| `headers` | `[x-op"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"encode-session, x-session-affinity, x-client-request-id, x-session-id]` | Request header names to in"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"ject |
| `extraHeaders` | `{}` | Optional static extra headers (e.g. opencode fingerprint family `x-"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"opencode-client: native` / `x-opencode-request: dsh`) |
| `userAgent` | empty | Override `User-Agent"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"` (opencode itself sends `opencode/<version>`; untouched by default) |
| `sessionIdEnv` | empty | En"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"vironment variable name to fall back on for the session id |
| `verbose` | `false` | Log every injec"},{"id":"p19s9","text":"tion (including the original id → wire token mapping) |
| `seedSessionId` | `false` | Seed `options."},{"id":"p19s10","text":"sessionId` for opencode routes |
| `nanoidSessionId` | `true` | Hash `session-<uuid>` to a nanoid(8)"},{"id":"p19s11","text":" before sending; `false` sends the raw id |
| `nanoidLength` | `8` | Token length (4–32) |
| `nanoid"},{"id":"p19s12","text":"Alphabet` | `alphanumeric` | `alphanumeric` (pure `A-Za-z0-9`, no `_`/`-`) or `urlsafe` (classic 64-"},{"id":"p19s13","text":"character set) |
| `disableFetchInjection` | `false` | When `true`, keep only the waterfall session "},{"id":"p19s14","text":" set) |
| `disableFetchInjection` | `false` | When `true`, keep only the waterfall session scoping |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Verification"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"`verify.mjs` fires a real `opencode-go` request through the pi-ai bundled with the dsh CLI, assertin"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"g that the wire request headers really carry the session id; it also verifies concurrent-session iso"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"lation and that non-opencode endpoints are unaffected."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Notes & limitations"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- The session id comes from `options.sessionId` (agent-loop fills it in per session); without a sess"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ion context, the fallback chain is `sessionIdEnv` > `DSH_SESSION_ID` (the process's startup session "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"in web deployments) > an in-process random id.
- Covers protocols that go through `fetch`, such as `"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"openai-completions` / `openai-responses` / `anthropic-messages`; `transport: websocket` does not use"},{"id":"p24s5","text":" fetch and is out of scope.
- The global fetch wrapper only appends request headers when an opencode"},{"id":"p24s6","text":" endpoint is matched — nothing else is changed. The wire token is a one-way SHA-256 hash of the uuid"},{"id":"p24s7","text":" portion of `session-<uuid>` (the `session-` prefix excluded, e.g. `0RpJJnxJ`), so the backend canno"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"t reverse it to the original id; changing `nanoidAlphabet` / `nanoidLength` changes every token, bre"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"aking association with old records."}],"truncated":false}
